articles.translatedTitle: Green Yellow Society will release the MV for “Utamago” filmed at Chukyo University Chukyo, the place where they were formed.
articles.translatedExcerpt: Green Yellow Society has announced that the music video for their latest song "Utamago" will be premiered at 12:00 on November 28, 2026. This song is included in their 6th album "Atamago" released on September 9th, and was written and composed by Haruko Nagaya (Vo). The song was created with the concept of looking back on how they felt when they first started the band, and wanting to create a song that would be like a school song for the green-yellow society. The MV was filmed at Chukyo University Chukyo High School, the alma mater of Haruko Nagaya, Issei Kobayashi (G), and Peppe (Key), and where the band was formed. In addition to footage of the members performing in the band research club room and gymnasium, which are full of memories, the casual daily lives of current students are shown, such as the nostalgic scenery of the school building, how they devote themselves to club activities, and how they enjoy time with friends, resulting in a video full of the sparkle of youth and nostalgia.

articles.translatedExcerpt: YOSHIKI made a surprise appearance at Ebisu Garden Place in Tokyo on November 20, 2026, his birthday. Two songs, "Silent Night" and X JAPAN's representative song "ENDLESS RAIN", were performed on a crystal piano while the world's largest Baccarat chandelier shone. When the performance ended, congratulations and voices of "Happy Birthday!" rose up from the audience. On this day, a birthday special lasting approximately 9 hours will be broadcast live on the official distribution program "YOSHIKI CHANNEL". YOSHIKI visited various places in Tokyo and appeared at Ebisu Garden Place at night, where the chandeliers of Baccarat, a French crystal maison with a history of over 260 years, illuminated the city during the Christmas season. A transparent piano shines in the light of the chandelier, and “ENDLES” appears in the winter plaza.

articles.translatedTitle: The movie “Do you love each other?” “What Kiyoshiro Imawano taught me” is a long hit.
articles.translatedExcerpt: The movie “Are you in love?” depicting the trajectory of Kiyoshiro Imawano. ``Kiyoshiro Imawano Taught Me'' has been a long hit. Kiyoshiro Imawano continued to sing since forming RC Succession on November 23, 1968 while still in high school until his death on May 2, 2009. This is a documentary commemorating the 55th anniversary of Kiyoshiro's debut, tracing the path of Kiyoshiro Imawano, who brought about change in the Japanese music scene with love and rebellion in his heart, and approaches the essence of his unparalleled expression. Recording scenery, a keen eye on society, and numerous events that caused a stir in the world. This work deeply delves into his ``attitude to stick to his beliefs'' and ``unique performance'' from multiple angles. Since the screening began in October, the film has not only been shown at movie theaters across the country, but also held special screenings, talk shows, listening events at CD shops, and special features on terrestrial television programs, making it a big hit across generations.

articles.translatedTitle: LIL LEAGUE releases new visual and jacket for 7th single “BAD BOYS”
articles.translatedExcerpt: LIL LEAGUE has announced the title of their 7th single, which will be released on Wednesday, December 23rd, is "BAD BOYS." A new visual and jacket have also been released. The title of the single has not been revealed so far, only that the title song is a work for everyone who is tired of being a "good person". Meanwhile, a short documentary titled "Who we are" has been released on social media since last week, featuring footage of the members speaking from their hearts. While some fans speculated that it might be a hint of the 7th single, causing controversy, the title ``7th Single BAD BOYS'' was revealed for the first time in the final post of the short documentary. The new visual features black-based clothing against a background of a pile of boards with messages and icons drawn on them.

articles.translatedTitle: Aooo announces national hall tour <HIRAHIRA> next spring with first performance at Nippon Budokan
articles.translatedExcerpt: Aooo announced at their first Nippon Budokan performance <Budookan> held on November 22nd (Sunday) that they will be holding a nationwide hall tour <Aooo Live Tour “HIRAHIRA” (pronunciation: Hirahira) from April 2027. <Budookan> was sold out and attracted approximately 9,000 people. <HIRAHIRA>, which was announced at the encore MC, will tour 10 performances in 9 cities across the country, starting at Yokosuka Arts Theater in Kanagawa on Thursday, April 8th, and ending at SGC Hall Ariake in Tokyo on Saturday, July 3rd. Additionally, the video content that will be included in the first limited edition has also been released. First limited edition A includes the daytime performance of the 5th anniversary live held in September this year <Miho Okasaki 5th ANNIVERSARY LIVE Floria ~Boku no Kodo~ supported by animelo>, while first limited edition B includes the evening performance <Miho Okasaki 5th ANNIVERSARY LIVE Floria ~Boku no Kodo~ supported by animelo>.

This song also depicts the feelings of overcoming the anxiety and misunderstandings experienced in past relationships and trying to cherish the current relationship. articles.translatedTitle: mol-74 Kazuki Takeichi's solo project Alt Quark releases first MV "Tsuki no Oi"
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alt Quark, the solo project of mol-74 vocalist Kazuki Takeichi, has released the music video for "Tsuki no Oi", which was digitally released on November 18, 2026. This is Alt Quark's first music video. The MV is set in a coin laundry at night. The film is a quiet, cinematic film that carefully captures everyday fragments of everyday life, centering on a story about the memory of smells. The tranquil and unpretentious world view of the song, which is played on the piano, and the natural atmosphere of the video harmonize beautifully. The director was Yutaka Tsunemaji, who is active in a wide range of fields including movies, dramas, and music videos. His directorial work ``Kono Hibi ga Calm'' was officially invited to the 45th Moscow International Film Festival, and he has also worked on music videos for many artists such as Hitsuji Bungaku, Uru, and Ikimonogakari.

The new single "Futsu", which was released for the first time in about eight years, contains three rock songs with outstanding sharpness: "Iraira", "Hitori", and "Metal Man 5". The title song "Iraza" is a short tune that, as the title suggests, uses the emotion of "irritation" as its engine. ``The power of irritation'' and ``stress is power'' and the thrill of not just canceling out frustration and stress, but turning it into the strength to move forward is unique to Rapid Tokyo. The phrases ``Sore-ish'' and ``That-like'' are played on like a play on words, and seem to be an ironic take on the current world, which is full of borrowed words and ``uniqueness.'' articles.translatedExcerpt: Singer-songwriter Yuta Orisaka will release his fifth full-length album, "Fuyuutama," on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, approximately two and a half years after his previous album, "Shoujo." For Orisaka, who announced her independence from her agency at the end of October this year, this is the first work to mark a new start. This is the first album release in about 10 years since ``Tamuke'' from the label ``Noroshi Records'', which he founded with Fumi Matsui and Hajime Yaku in the early days of his career. This work is a concept album with a total of 10 songs created with the theme of "winter". This work depicts multifaceted moods and emotions, including songs that color the seasons such as the Christmas song "Watayuki," "Yuzu," which depicts the calm and warmth of New Year's Eve, and "Kusudama," which evokes the light of the new year, as well as "Fuyuugare," which reflects the harsh winter scenery, and labelmate Aya Matsui's song "NOT MY DAY."

articles.translatedExcerpt: Keisuke Kuwata has announced that he will appear on Nippon Television's music festival "Best Artist 2026", which will be broadcast live on November 28, 2026, for the first time in five years. "Best Artist" is celebrating its 25th anniversary this year since it began broadcasting in 2001. The theme for 2026 is "Musical Journey," and it will be a 5-hour live broadcast featuring a total of about 40 artists, looking back on the past year with music. In this memorable year, Keisuke Kuwata will appear for the first time in five years. The song they will be performing this time is "Tasuki of the Gods," the theme song for the Nippon Television drama "Oretachi no Hakone Ekiden," which is currently being aired. The latest song was just released on November 16th and has not been performed live yet, and will be sung for the first time on TV on the "Best Artist 2026" stage. This song, set at the Hakone Ekiden, is not only for the runners, but also for supporting and cheering on their challenges...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Takashi Hosokawa has released the music video for his new song "Otoko no Umi" released today. Following the previous work ``Kamui Misaki'', this work is also produced entirely by AI. Hosokawa's singing ability and the unpredictable visual world created by AI have once again fused together to create a "problem work" that will leave viewers stunned. The impetus was the release of the music video for his previous work, ``Kamui Misaki''. The video, which was produced entirely using AI, was filled with a lot of information and chaotically unfolding, and the comment section was filled with loving comments such as, ``The video is so distracting that I can't really get into the song's content,'' ``It's a waste of a legend (compliment),'' and ``The evolution of AI and Takashi Hosokawa's dignity are causing a traffic jam.'' articles.translatedTitle: Gang of Youths releases disturbing new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Gang of Youths released their new single "Benny's Video" on Thursday, November 12, 2026. This work is the second single from the 4th album "Compañero" scheduled to be released next March. The 1992 film Benny's Video was a source of inspiration for the song, and the film's disturbing atmosphere and themes surrounding human psychology and violence are reflected in the song's dark worldview. articles.translatedTitle: Yasushi Nakanishi announces all participating artists in new collaboration AL
articles.translatedExcerpt: All participating artists have been announced for Yasushi Nakanishi's second collaborative album, ``BONUS TRACKs beyond ~Kansen no Uta'', which will be released on December 9th (Wednesday). New participants announced include Yasuhiro Suzuki, Keizo Nakanishi, and Baby Boo. He met Yasuhiro Suzuki when he appeared on the radio to promote his previous work, and ended up singing Kozo Murashita's famous song "Yuko." With Keizo Nakanishi, who co-starred in the previous work, Yasushi Nakanishi vowed that ``only these two would sing together,'' and the song ``Nishiki no Uta'', which has been loved by fans for many years, will be included on the CD for the first time. Baby Boo will sing Billy Joel's famous song ``The Longest Time,'' which Yasushi Nakanishi said he sang with his friends on the banks of the Kamogawa River in Kyoto during his youth. Also included is his first local song ``NARA...'', which is filled with his feelings for Nara Prefecture, where he was born and raised. What comes to mind when you hear Nara...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Keisuke Kuwata's new song ``Tasuki of the Gods'' (the theme song for the Nippon Television drama ``Oretachi no Hakone Ekiden'') has been released today, November 16th (Monday). To commemorate this release, comments on the song from the original author of the drama, Jun Ikeido, have also arrived, and the second drama special trailer has also been released. ``Tasuki of the Gods'' is an anthem set in the Hakone Ekiden that connects the ensemble drama from the perspectives of not only the runners, but also those who support and cheer on the challenge, through the ``sash'' of music. It opens with an intro that sounds like a tense heartbeat waiting for the starting gun, and as the story progresses, the sound becomes more dynamic, and eventually expands exhilaratingly, like a sparkling wind blowing through. What emerges from the scenery of Hakone Road is the passion of the people, which cannot be expressed only by wins and losses. Supporting all those who face challenges and follow the path they have chosen...
